units.source_text: 紫姬以小女公子爱好为借口，也恋恋不舍地贪看故事小说。

en.t: Lady Murasaki used the little princess's fondness for them as an excuse, and she too lingered over the tales, reluctant to put them down.

units.source_text: 她看了《狛野物语》的画卷，

en.t: When she looked at the illustrated scroll of The Tale of Komano,

units.source_text: 赞道：“这些画画得真好啊！”

en.t: she praised it, saying, "These pictures are beautifully painted!"

units.source_text: 她看到其中有一个小姑娘无心无思地昼寝着，便回想起自己幼时的情况。

en.t: Seeing in it a little girl sleeping innocently in the daytime, she thought back to her own childhood.

units.source_text: 源氏对她说道：“这小小年纪，便已如此懂得恋情。

en.t: Genji said to her, "At such a tender age, she already understands love so well.

units.source_text: 可见像我这样耐心等待，是常人所做不到的，是可作模范的了。”

en.t: That shows that waiting patiently as I have done is beyond ordinary people, and may even serve as a model."

units.source_text: 的确，源氏在恋爱上经验丰富，竟是少有其例的。

en.t: Indeed, Genji was so experienced in love that he was almost without equal.

units.source_text: 他又说：“在小女儿面前，不可阅读此种色情故事。

en.t: He also said, "One must not read this sort of amorous tale in front of a little girl.

units.source_text: 对于故事中那些偷情窃爱的女子，她虽然不会深感兴趣，但她看见此种事情乃世间所常有，认为无关紧要，那就不得了啊！”

en.t: She may not take a deep interest in the women in these stories who carry on secret love affairs, but if she sees such things as common in the world and thinks they are of no consequence, that would be dreadful!"

units.source_text: 如此关怀周到的话，倘被玉鬘听到了，

en.t: If Tamakazura had heard such thoughtful and attentive words of concern,

units.source_text: 一定觉得亲生女儿毕竟不同，因而自伤命薄吧。

en.t: she would surely have felt that a true daughter was treated differently after all, and would have grieved over her own unfortunate lot.
